shortBio.en: Metallica vocals/rhythm-guitar pillar; downpicked riff engine and barked verse as thrash mass grammar.
shortBio.zh: Metallica 人声/节奏吉他支柱；下拨 riff 引擎与吼叫主歌即 thrash 大众语法。

whyHub.en: Rhythm guitar + lead voice fused: Hetfield’s right hand is the band’s tempo and identity across bassists and eras.
whyHub.zh: 节奏吉他与主唱合一：Hetfield 右手是跨贝斯手与时代的速度与身份。

body.en:
Born 1963. Co-founds Metallica with Ulrich; Kill ’Em All → Master of Puppets locks downpicking, palm mute, and gallop figures as thrash default. Cliff Burton then Newsted then Trujillo change the low end; Hetfield/Ulrich writing core stays.

Black Album (1991) scales the same right-hand attack to radio hard rock. Hub is continuity of rhythm-guitar leadership, not a revolving frontman brand.
body.zh:
1963 年生。与 Ulrich 共创 Metallica；Kill ’Em All → Master of Puppets 把下拨、掌闷与 gallop 定为 thrash 默认。Cliff Burton、Newsted、Trujillo 换低频；Hetfield/Ulrich 写作核不变。

Black Album（1991）把同一右手攻击扩到电台硬摇滚。枢纽是节奏吉他领导权的连续，而非轮换主唱品牌。

note.en: Founding vocals/rhythm guitar through thrash peak and stadium era.
note.zh: 创始人声/节奏吉他，贯穿 thrash 巅峰与体育场时代。
